links.rationale: Approved by the C2-a (Phase 11) editorial review during the readiness-evidence authoring of res-hedge-i-think. What that review covered: the row's provenance (declared by the P3-1A/P3-1B fixture, unchanged), the target's evidence document (content_src/evidence/res-hedge-i-think.json, authored and reviewed in C2-a), and that this approval is what makes §8.1 R2's curriculum_link fact readable for the target. What it did NOT cover, stated so the approval is not read as more than it is: cap-eval-hedged-opinion has no functional definition in this repository, so no capability-semantics audit of the mapping was possible and this approval is no capability certification — whether res-hedge-i-think really realizes that capability stays as unreviewed as curriculum/README.md C2 records. With the approval in place the target's ALTERNATIVE_SUCCESS path can mint CAPABILITY/POSITIVE learner evidence (live risk R-C1-credit, bounded by the real rollout HOLD). Revisit when the capability definitions land.
